name: energy_inversion
summary: For every L2-normalized embedding (any of the 5 axes: vector/wave/time/sentence/svg), compute the antipodal twin (-vec) and encode both as hex via int8 quantization. The pair (forward_hex, inverted_hex, energy, crystal) is self-verifying via differential-amplifier residual check: byte-wise sign-flip must hold. Adds NEGATION RETRIEVAL — for every forward query, also retrieve the antithesis. Effectively doubles the MoE retrieval surface from 5 axes to 10 (5 forward + 5 inverted) with zero new compute.
engine_pattern: stateless transform. int8 quantization → hex pack → optional crystal hash. Same math invariants as the inverted-time arm in tri_modal_embedder, generalized to any embedding.

the_three_capabilities.1_compact_storage: int8 hex is 1/8 the size of JSON-encoded float64. 64-d vector → 128 hex chars (64 bytes) vs ~1000 chars JSON.
the_three_capabilities.2_tamper_evident: Pair (forward_hex, inverted_hex) is byte-wise antipodal. Any single-byte flip breaks the antipodal residual (max_residual jumps from ~0 to >0.1) AND the crystal hash mismatches. Differential-amplifier at every embedding.
the_three_capabilities.3_negation_retrieval: For query q, look up matches AGAINST -q to find the antithesis. 'find me modern minimalist' + look at -q → 'find me cluttered traditional'. The chain learns by both proximity AND opposition. Same cost as forward retrieval.

quantization.scheme: int8 symmetric ([-127, 127]) — drops -128 for sign symmetry
quantization.storage_per_64d_vec: 64 bytes / 128 hex chars (forward) + same (inverted) = 256 hex chars per pair

inbound_callers: tri_modal_embedder (every wave_emb gets an antipodal twin)
tri_modal_embedder.time_vector (already has forward + inverted arms — energy_inversion makes hex-stable)

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.pair_generation: 64-d L2-normed vec → 128-char hex forward + 128-char hex inverted + energy=1.0 + 64-char crystal
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.negation_retrieval: query q against fake corpus → antipodal beta sim=1.0 · identical alpha sim=-1.0 · orthogonal gamma sim=~0 (correct)

what_changes_with_this.before: 5 forward retrieval axes: vector / wave / time / sentence / svg
what_changes_with_this.storage: crystal chain records can now carry compact int8 hex twins instead of JSON float arrays — 8× smaller
what_changes_with_this.verification: every embedding in the chain has byte-level tamper detection (was only on time vector before)

guarantees: Deterministic — same vec → same hex pair → same crystal, byte-exact
Tamper-evident at the byte level (single-byte flip breaks pair)
Energy-preserving — quantization noise bounded by 1/127 ≈ 0.008 per component
L2 norm preserved within quantization tolerance
Pure stdlib — no numpy, no struct, no msgpack
usage_example: from energy_inversion import make_pair, find_antithesis\npair = make_pair(my_wave_emb)            # → forward_hex + inverted_hex + crystal\nantitheses = find_antithesis(query_emb, corpus, k=5)  # negation lens
